name: gen-image
description: Generate and edit images via Google's Gemini image models (nano banana) OpenAI's GPT Image models (API key), or Codex CLI ($imagegen on a ChatGPT subscription) — single-shot text-to-image, image editing, and style-referenced generation from a zero-dependency Node CLI.

prerequisites.name: node
prerequisites.install_hint: Install Node.js from https://nodejs.org/ — the gen-image CLI is a Node script.

install.notes: No software to install; the CLI ships inside the skill folder. Requires a Google AI Studio API key — see post_install_hints.

post_install_hints: gen-image needs a Google AI Studio API key (https://aistudio.google.com/apikey) for Gemini models, and/or an OpenAI API key (https://platform.openai.com/api-keys) for gpt-image models.
Set once per machine: environment variables GOOGLE_API_KEY / OPENAI_API_KEY (preferred), or write to ~/.claude/.google-api-key / ~/.claude/.openai-api-key.
Per-project override: a GOOGLE_API_KEY= / OPENAI_API_KEY= line in the project's .env (must be gitignored).
